claims.statement: XMX sg16 compiles and runs on the B60 with icpx 2026.2 (headers present; bench builds and runs)
Decode batch M=1 is bandwidth-bound: joint_matrix f16 moves 6.55MB in 22.2us (~295 GB/s), int8 halves bytes to 11.1us
Strata decode GEMV is scalar on CUDA and SYCL; joint_matrix serves expert set tiles only
Upstream merged decode-side XMX path is ESIMD DPAS int8 multi-column MMV (PR #29864), Xe2-only, reorder layout, 1-80 cols
Upstream joint_matrix path is grouped MoE GEMM (PR #29245), IQ + K-quants, KSPLIT=4
dkhaldi supplies the joint_matrix API cookbook: load/mad/store, load_checked/store_checked, prefetch hint L1, joint_matrix_apply, ext_intel_packed VNNI, M=1 reduce variant
vllm PR #644 shows a pure-SYCL sg16 int4 GEMV beats CUTLASS grouped GEMM at rows<=8 (56->18us gate_up, 34->14us down, +14% decode) with device-side expert scan and no host sync
oneDNN has no GPU GEMV primitive; M=1 routes through systolic matmul with M-unroll floor 16; grouped_micro_gemm is the only is_gemv_ path
oneMKL gemv is dense float/double/complex only - no quantized decode surface
valarauca PR #1 is the richest XMX integration reference (FA joint_matrix default, MoE device routing, oneDNN reorder, fused GLU decode, graph replay) but is an open fork on B70, not upstream
'trellis' is Strata's ds4_tq.cu AMD WMMA path; absent from llama.cpp
